name: Stage 32: Stavsjö to Lövsjöns sydspets
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 32, Stavsjö to Lövsjöns sydspets.
utilities: Official area: Norrköpings kommun, Nyköpings kommun, Stavsjö.

Official distance is 11.5 km from Stavsjö to Lövsjöns sydspets; secondary GPS/map sources range about 10.3-12.0 km. Use official 11.5 km as the headline and treat drawn/OSM geometry as planning support.

Use the official/Naturkartan Stage 32 line as the main route, reversed into the named Stavsjö-to-Lövsjön direction. Naturkartan site 73422 measures about 10.3 km/10315 m while the catalog distance is 11.5 km; OSM relation 3692978 measures about 11.9 km but has small disconnected chains near Stavsjö.

Easy to moderate forest stage: Skiren shore and early swim/rest options, mixed forest and clearcut, connection with 31:1 at Skjutgropen after about 4 km, the old Nunnebanan rail embankment, long mire/boardwalk sections, then Lövsjön's west and south shore.
Stavsjö is the practical northern service point with bus 563 context, parking, food/service at Stavsjö Krog/Circle K, and nearby lodging whose current booking status should be verified.

Lövsjön shelter is the main overnight/rest node with shelter, fireplace/grill, dry toilet and lake access. Östgötaleden describes floor space for about 4-5 people; no booking, bins, firewood or toilet paper should be assumed.

Kolmårdens djurpark connects to the south end via stage 32:2, a blue-marked gravel-road connector. This is often the stronger transit/parking access at the southern end than trying to rely on the small Lövsjön endpoint parking.
waterSources: Lugnet spring at 58.712000, 16.403383 is the only official water source for stage 32 and is about 600 m off the main trail after roughly 5 km. Treat/filter/boil and carry backup.
Do not merge the official Lugnet spring with unrelated OSM spring pins near the route; the official source is an off-route detour and no recent independent flow report was found.
Skiren and Lövsjön are natural lake/bathing water only, not potable refills. Official text describes Skiren as clear/fine bathing water, but that is not drinking-water proof.
Do not mark the Lövsjön shelter as a potable water point just because secondary facility imports list water/shoreline. Official drinking-water listing is Lugnet.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.
Official stage 32 page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-27 research pass.

Current-condition caveat: route-specific reports through March 2025 still describe the long bog boardwalk as present and passable, though slippery in snow/slush and with an older rotting bench beside a newer one. Separate reports about rotten boardwalks/repairs in the wider Hjortronmossen/Lövsjöstigen area should be treated as condition warnings, not an official Stage 32 closure unless confirmed.
Nearby-loop caveat: Länsstyrelsen says Lövsjöstigen in Fjällmossen is closed during 2026 due fallen trees and poor boardwalks. This is a nearby loop, not confirmed as a stage 32 closure.

Southern Lövsjön/Fjällmossen context has reserve/Natura 2000 rules: no tenting/camping or caravans, dogs leashed, no off-road driving/parking, do not damage living/dead trees or shrubs, and fires only where signs/rules permit. Apply the strictest posted rule locally.
Hjortronmossen/Nävsjömossen reserve context includes leashed pets, no collecting mosses/lichens/wood fungi, no disturbing wildlife, and fires only at arranged grill sites.

Kokärrets gammelskog is nearby/side-access context rather than a main-stage facility. If entering the reserve, pets must be leashed and fires, camping, plant/wood removal and wildlife disturbance are restricted; the reserve has no visitor facilities.
Erikslund/Nunnebanan reserve context near the route has strict fire/camping restrictions and only tiny parking context by the old railway; do not present it as a service stop.
Sörmlandsleden shelters are free, first-come, non-bookable and must be shared if space remains. No bins or firewood should be assumed.

Use prepared fireplaces only when current fire bans/brandrisk allow. During stricter fire bans even fixed public grill sites can be prohibited; check Krisinformation/MSB Brandrisk Ute and current municipal/county pages.

Fishing in Skiren/Stavsjön and parts of Lövsjön requires a local permit. Source links conflict slightly between Sörmlandsleden/iFiske and Nyköping/Naturkartan/Stavsjö Krog references, so users should verify the correct water before buying.
Skiren and Lövsjön swim spots are informal lake access only. No matching authority bathing-water listing was verified for these Stage 32 spots; avoid claiming sampled bathing quality.

Recent non-official reports describe clear signage, including at the 31:1 junction and blue-marked 32:2 connector, but wet/slippery footing can occur around the bog boardwalk and Lövsjön. Multiple nearby alternatives mean users should watch signs for Skiren runt, 31:1, 32:2 and Kokärret side paths.

Endpoint geometry varies by source around Lövsjöns south tip and the 32:2 junction. Stage 33's official start near 58.680200, 16.477983 and OSM's common junction near 58.679192, 16.477323 are close enough for planning but should be treated cautiously for precise navigation.

facilities.name: Stavsjö stage start
facilities.description: Official stage start by the old inn/hostel area. Parking, bus and lodging/service contexts are nearby but should be verified live.

facilities.name: Stavsjö start parking context
facilities.description: Parking context near the Stavsjö start/old inn area; official text says parking exists in Stavsjö. Check local signs and visitor-use rules.

facilities.name: Stavsjö Krog & Kafé services
facilities.description: Nearby food/cafe/service anchor near the start, with daily 08:00-20:00 hours as checked. Verify current opening before relying on it.

facilities.name: Stavsjö hostel/lodging caveat
facilities.description: Official text still uses the hostel/old inn as a landmark, but current bookability/branding is inconsistent. Verify accommodation before routing users there.

facilities.name: Stavsjöbadet nearby bathing place
facilities.description: Nearby managed bathing place on Stavsjön, not on the Skiren/Lövsjön stage shore. Naturkartan lists jetty, fire site, parking and toilet; HaV 2025 classification for 2026 was excellent.

facilities.name: Skiren swim/rest shore
facilities.description: Official text describes several early swim/rest opportunities along Skiren and very clear water. No municipal bathing-water sample point was verified here; fishing requires permit.

facilities.name: Skiren south benches/rest
facilities.description: Benches/picnic stop by Skiren, confirmed by recent hiker report and OSM picnic-table data. Good early break point but exposed in poor weather.

facilities.name: Skiren / Lövsjön fishing permit warning
facilities.description: Fishing in Skiren/Stavsjön and parts of Lövsjön requires a local permit; fishing is not covered by allemansrätten. Sörmlandsleden/iFiske and Nyköping/Naturkartan/Stavsjö Krog sources are not perfectly aligned, so verify the exact water before buying.

facilities.name: Lugnet spring
facilities.description: Official water source about 600 m off the main trail after roughly 5 km; stage maintainer recommends the detour. Treat/filter/boil and verify flow.

facilities.name: Skjutgropen / stage 31:1 junction
facilities.description: Stage 32 meets connector 31:1 after about 4 km from Stavsjö. Use this route junction, not the named Skjutgropen locality east of the trail.

facilities.name: Nunnebanan rail embankment
facilities.description: Historic rail-bank section after the 31:1 junction, built after nun moth damage in the early 1900s. Cultural/route-character marker rather than a facility.

facilities.name: Kokärrets gammelskog side context
facilities.description: Nearby/side-access reserve around Nöden/Kokärret, not a main-stage service stop. Länsstyrelsen notes no trails, parking or visitor facilities; pets leashed, no fire, no camping, no damaging/removing vegetation/wood/fungi/moss/lichen, and avoid disturbing wildlife.

facilities.name: Erikslund / Nunnebanan reserve context
facilities.description: Reserve/old-railway context near Nunnebanan. Länsstyrelsen mentions only tiny parking by Nunnebanan and reserve rules prohibit fire and camping; do not present as a trail service.

facilities.name: Hjortronmossen boardwalk condition
facilities.description: Long wetland/boardwalk area. Route-specific reports through March 2025 still found the boardwalk usable, though slippery in snow/slush; wider 2025-2026 reports about rotten boardwalks/repairs should be treated as a condition warning unless an official Stage 32 closure appears.

facilities.name: Bog boardwalk bench/rest
facilities.description: Long bog boardwalk with a bench/fika spot from OSM and recent blogs. 2025 reports note a new/stable bench and an older rotting bench beside it; footing can be slippery in snow/slush and waterlogged near the boards.

facilities.name: Lövsjön shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter on Lövsjön's west shore after about 9.5 km; Naturkartan/OSM/Vindskyddskartan align closely. Östgötaleden describes floor space for about 4-5 people. Free, first-come, non-bookable and shared when space remains.

facilities.name: Lövsjön shelter fireplace
facilities.description: Prepared fire/grill context at the shelter. Use only when current fire rules allow; no firewood guarantee and no trash bins.

facilities.name: Lövsjön dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet beside/near the Lövsjön shelter, confirmed by official text, Östgötaleden and OSM. Bring paper/sanitizer and verify condition on arrival.

facilities.name: Lövsjön facility-cluster alternate pin
facilities.description: Secondary Grillplatser/Nyköping imported shelter/fire/toilet/swim coordinate is offset about 100-150 m from the official shelter. Treat as same facility cluster, not a separate shelter.

facilities.name: Lövsjön swim/rest shore
facilities.description: Lake-shore rest/swim context near the shelter and along the southbound continuation. Natural lake water only, not potable.

facilities.name: Lövsjön south informal tent/rest caveat
facilities.description: Recent reports and forum notes say flatter lake-view rest/tent spots may exist a few hundred metres south of the shelter, while the shelter area itself is stony/sloping. This is not an official campsite; Fjällmossen no-camping rules, local signs and sensitive ground override allemansrätten.

facilities.name: Lövsjön southern fire/rest point
facilities.description: Mapped picnic/fireplace point south of the shelter near the route continuation. Reserve/fire rules apply.

facilities.name: Fjällmossen reserve rules near Lövsjön
facilities.description: Southern Lövsjön/Fjällmossen context: no tenting/camping, dogs leashed, fires only at designated places, and do not damage living/dead trees. Follow posted signs.

facilities.name: Lövsjöstigen nearby-loop closure
facilities.description: Länsstyrelsen says nearby Lövsjöstigen is closed during 2026 because of fallen trees and poor boardwalks. This is not confirmed as a stage 32 closure.

facilities.name: Lövsjöns sydspets stage end
facilities.description: Official stage-33 start coordinate and best shared endpoint for stage 32. Official text says small parking and rest/swim possible; exact parking pin varies by source.

facilities.name: Lövsjön common route junction
facilities.description: OSM common endpoint for stage 32, stage 33 and connector 32:2; useful for topology but coordinate differs slightly from official stage-33 start.

facilities.name: Lövsjön/Fjällmossen parking east
facilities.description: Länsstyrelsen/OSM parking context east of Lövsjön from the Kolmården/Fjällmossen direction. Not the same as the small stage-end parking.

facilities.name: Kolmården connector 32:2 access
facilities.description: Official start of the blue-marked 1.5 km connector from Kolmårdens djurpark to Lövsjöns sydspets. Strong transit/parking access via Kolmårdens Djurpark stop, but park/hotel services are seasonal/opening-hour dependent and bus tickets may cross operators/zones.

facilities.name: Kolmårdens djurpark parking
facilities.description: Paid visitor parking/EV charging context for accessing 32:2 and southern stage 32. Check current Kolmården parking fees and opening context.
